import urllib.request
import json

def get_refseq_info(term):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=protein&term={term}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]+AND+refseq[filter]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        ids = data["esearchresult"]["idlist"][:5]
    
    summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(ids)}&retmode=json"
    req2 = urllib.request.Request(summary_url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as resp:
        sum_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        for i in ids:
            item = sum_data["result"][i]
            print(f"{term}: {item['caption']} ({item['title']}) - length: {item.get('slen')}")

get_refseq_info("JARID2")
get_refseq_info("LRRC32")

        sum_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
